fact_check_log.claim: Names, addresses and phone numbers are all examples of personal information (OAIC link at claim; email not claimed).
The Privacy Act does not cover individuals acting in a personal capacity (OAIC link at claim; framed as general information as at November 2026, not legal advice).
In some situations state or territory laws may also apply.
Scammers can use QR codes to hide harmful links (ACSC cyber.gov.au link at claim).
A guest cannot check where a QR code leads before scanning it.
A Wedded Advisor plans venue, travel, vendors and payments anywhere in the world, one point of contact start to finish, works in your time zone.
Advisor quotes in AUD and confirms inclusions in writing before you commit.
Wonderland Studio is our planning app for seating charts and RSVPs.
Timing (before / on / after the reply date), three steps at most, household reminders, call and card advice, counting a quiet guest.

issues: No prices, no 'best', 'free', statistics, day or week counts, platform or vendor names, competitor names, Spam Act or messaging-law claims. Privacy line is marked general information as at November 2026, not legal advice; no claim that any law does or does not apply to the couple. 'at most' (Plan on three steps at most; FAQ) is a cap, not a statistic. Approved Wonderland Studio wording is enforced by edit 8, and the AUD qualifier by edit 9.
